lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical high-contrast white line segments traverse the lateral torso. Spacing is generally uniform across the central torso mass, with slightly tighter grouping observed among the three most anterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The two most posterior lines and the two most anterior lines are truncated, terminating at approximately 30-50% of the vertical height of the central lines and failing to reach the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 distinct white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch and proximal hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of 3 spots is observable at the posterior-most edge of the haunch, forming a short geometric row.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white spot markings in the inter-orbital facial region and a prominent white patch on the ventral neck/throat area.
